questions.title: Rough endoplasmic reticulum's role in protein export
questions.question: Rough endoplasmic reticulum plays an important role in which of the following processes?

options.A: Synthesizing proteins that secreted outside the cell
options.B: Producing and secreting massive amounts of lipid molecules
options.C: Synthesizing proteins that used inside the cell

explanations.A: Correct. Rough endoplasmic reticulum is flattened cisternae studded on the outside with ribosomes bound to receptor proteins. It makes and segregates protein for export — that is, protein destined to be secreted outside the cell. A protein-secreting gland cell, such as a plasma cell or a pancreatic acinar cell, is rich in rough ER for exactly this reason.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Lipid synthesis is chiefly the role of SMOOTH endoplasmic reticulum, not the ribosome-studded rough ER.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Proteins used INSIDE the cell (cytosolic proteins) are typically made on FREE ribosomes in the cytoplasm, not on the rough ER, which is dedicated to proteins destined for export, the membrane, or organelles of the secretory pathway.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Digesting old organelles is the lysosome's role (via autophagy), not the rough ER's.

questions.learning_objective: State that rough endoplasmic reticulum synthesises and segregates protein destined for export.
